_about: The route-feel gate's stated reasons (node tools/flow-audit.js gate; docs/ROUTE-FEEL.md). Each row accepts one check the candidate's flow audit fails against the shipped guides: `check` (score, backtracks_avoidable, passed_givers_near, passed_enders for a guide; back_and_forth, wasted_min, carried_far, carried_hours, never_handed, log_cap for a branch), the `guide` or `branch` it names ("*" for all), and the `mode` and `faction` it holds in (left out or "*": all; "run*": every mode with dungeons on Run). `reason` says why the route is better that way for players, on our own evidence: levels, time carried, a dangerous spot, a fixed report. Rows sorted by faction, guide or branch, check.

reasons.reason: Mount Hyjal joins the Alliance route (2026-11-20 round, about 56.4 to 58.5): its one avoidable backtrack is about 190 yards back to Yashiro in Dae'gun for Blademaster's Bonfires, whose two bonfires lie on the walk to Renalard; the hand-in goes with Elaena's and Witherbeard's at the end of the Dae'gun sweep, and While-here offers it as the walk passes him. The redrawn 50-60 guides themselves have no avoidable backtrack left (flow audit, 28 branches).

Dun Morogh (Dwarf and Gnome starts): Grund and Gozwin (97277) is taken from Grund at Anvilmar's door after Grik'nir, on the walk north to the tunnel, instead of on the first Anvilmar visit, so its Snow Leopard Prowler (6) comes at about 5.4 instead of 4.8 (recordings: 25th percentile 4.82 at the old step); about 400 yd and under 4 minutes. The Riverglades are part of the route after Stranglethorn Vale: one walk back inside them, about 350 yards in Sunnyglade for Apprentice Claire's Abominable Magics, among about 90 quests that replace most of the grinding the 40-50 guides asked for (level model: about 1,160 to 280 minutes).

Seeking Wisdom (269, from Sven at 31, for Bishop Farthing in Stormwind on the Hillsbrad guide) was carried 118 minutes and is now carried a few minutes over two hours: Worgen in the Woods' Tainted Ones (30-31) moved to the end of the Duskwood visit, about a level later, because players met them at 29 (recordings: 25th percentile 29.8, 5 people died there). The Riverglades now come between Stranglethorn Vale and the Badlands & Hinterlands: the quests taken in Stranglethorn and at Thelsamar for the Badlands (Ghak Healtouch's mushrooms among them) ride through the zone, three more carried quests for about 90 more on the way.

Quests whose mobs are too high on the visit that passes their giver are now taken there and carried to the visit that does them, instead of walking past the giver and coming back for it: Syndicate Assassins (Southshore to the Arathi road), Tiger, Raptor and Panther Mastery and Troll Witchery (Stranglethorn's first and second loops to the later Stranglethorn visits), Claim Rackmore's Treasure! (first Desolace visit to the south loop) and Safety Checks (the 30-40 Badlands loop to the 40-50 one); and the Riverglades come between Stranglethorn and the Badlands, which the quests taken for the Badlands ride through. About 230 more quest-hours in the log (flow model), the quest log stays at 32 or under.
Mount Hyjal is part of the route (0.4.3): the six quests of the last trip are handed in after the zone instead of never; carrying them through Hyjal is the price.

The audit plays optional goals as not done, so it counts the quest as never handed in.

2026-11-20 round: Mount Hyjal joins the Alliance route between the Plaguelands and Silithus (85 quests, about 56.4 to 58.5), with about 19 minutes of ground walked twice between its camps (the Cradle, Dae'gun, Mourning's Rest), and the Tanaris, Un'Goro, Felwood and Winterspring guide now takes 56 quests instead of 21 over ground it partly walks twice (about 14 minutes more); the Plaguelands and Silithus guides lose about 17 minutes. Against that the route hands in about 90 more quests, carries about 360 fewer quest-hours and plays about 7.7 hours shorter to its end (flow audit, 28 branches).

Mount Hyjal is part of the Horde route (0.4.3), its quests in place of the Silithus guide's top-ups and Felwood's grinds: its two passes through Mourning's Rest and the rides back to Elderwild add about 19 minutes of ground walked twice per branch (flow audit, solo), while the reworked Horde 50-60 guides walk about 11 minutes less twice. The same audit's time to the end of the route drops from 91.7 to 82.7 hours. The route also hands in about 65 more quests than before (flow audit: 986 to 1,052), and the walking grows with them: the Riverglades and Shen'dralas add about 60 quests and 15 minutes of walking between levels 41 and 47, and the level tidy moves work to the visits whose level fits it (the Tarren Mill smithy and the Dalaran crater to the 38-39 Hillsbrad visit, Stranglethorn's 43-46 errands to 40-50/02's Grom'gol stop), which adds walks between those stops. None of it puts players on mobs two levels above them.
